errors.description: Slant offset, converted using belt-loop width as scale reference (a trouser belt loop being about 1.3 cm). Drawing: loop width 40px giving 30.8px/cm; pocket mouth (450,235) to (528,610), horizontal offset 78px = 2.5 cm - an exact match to the label. Render: loop width 45px giving 34.6px/cm; mouth (300,215) to (195,720), horizontal offset 105px = 3.0 cm. Roughly 20 percent over, but the belt-loop reference carries about plus/minus 0.5 cm of uncertainty at this resolution, so the render is close to and may be within tolerance.
errors.expected: 2.5 cm of horizontal slant across the pocket mouth
errors.correction: Set the pocket mouth so its lower end sits exactly 2.5 cm outboard of its upper end - a mouth that is near-vertical with just a fingerbreadth of drift toward the side seam over its full length.

errors.description: Pocket mouth length. Drawing: y=235 to 610 = 375px at 30.8px/cm, about 12.2 cm. Render: y=215 to 720 = 505px at 34.6px/cm, about 14.6 cm. About 2.4 cm longer than drawn, though still inside the normal range for a slant pocket mouth.
errors.expected: A pocket mouth of roughly 12 cm from the waistband seam to its lower terminus
errors.correction: Run the pocket mouth about 12 cm from the waistband seam down to a bar-tacked lower terminus, so the opening ends well above the level of the hip curve.

errors.description: Relationship of the pocket's lower end to the front crease. Drawing: the pocket's bottom terminus at (528,610) lands exactly on the full-length vertical crease line at x=530. Render: the pocket's bottom at x=195 sits well inboard of the visible crease at x=480-560, so the two never meet.
errors.expected: The pocket mouth's lower terminus falling on the pressed front crease
errors.actual: The lower terminus finishing a clear distance to the side-seam side of the crease
errors.correction: Position the pocket so its lower bar tack lands right on the pressed front crease line, with the mouth angling down and outward from the waistband to meet it.

lockedFeatures: Slant angle: 11.7 degrees from vertical measured in the render against 11.8 in the drawing - essentially exact, must survive
Contrast stripe IS present - a clearly visible taupe/warm-grey piping running the full length of the pocket opening
Stripe rendered in a neutral tone rather than tracing the drawing's red guide line
Pocket mouth beginning at the waistband seam, exactly as drawn
Slant direction correct: the mouth drifts toward the side seam as it descends
Three belt loops on the waistband, matching the drawing's count
Crisp jetted/piped pocket construction with clean pressed edges and no gaping
No numerals, arrows, ruler ticks or red guide lines traced into the photograph
notes: The strongest of its batch and the closest of the whole wave. Both required features check out: slant measured at 11.7 degrees from vertical against 11.8 drawn, and the contrast stripe is unambiguously present as a lighter taupe piping along the whole opening. Deviations are modest - slant offset about 3.0 cm against 2.5 specified with real plus/minus 0.5 uncertainty from the belt-loop scale, mouth about 2.4 cm longer than drawn, and the lower terminus not landing on the crease. The drawing's rear welt pocket is out of frame in a front-hip crop, which was NOT counted against the render. The drawing's viewpoint handedness could not be independently verified, so slant direction was judged relative to the crease and side seam in each image rather than absolutely.
